tools.name: expected_strokes
tools.description: How many strokes the average PGA Tour player takes to hole out from a given lie and distance, from Mark Broadie's tables. The building block of strokes gained.

tools.name: strokes_gained
tools.description: Strokes gained for every shot of one or more holes, and the totals by category: off the tee, approach, around the green (30 yards and in) and putting. Measured against a scratch golfer by default, with the PGA Tour figure alongside; set baseline to "tour", or to "handicap" with the index, to grade t

tools.description: How many strokes per 18 holes a typical golfer of a given handicap loses to a scratch golfer, in the long game (tee shots and approaches), the short game, from sand and putting, and how much the average PGA Tour player gains on scratch.
